name: TRK-R
description: TRK-R was a loader droid who worked in a settlement on the planet Serelia during the time of the Galactic Empire, transporting cargo using a landspeeder. The droid was present at a dock on Serelia to collect a cargo of fish from the resident Verla when Jedi trainee Luke Skywalker visited the planet, having been called there in a Force vision. Verla, believing she would be hunted down for being Force-sensitive, dropped the catch of fish to distract Skywalker, which also knocked down TRK-R.
